dogecoin.text: @MEXC_Listings I've seen some memecoins go from jokes to serious projects with real communities behind them. Do you think $TST is just a short-lived hype cycle, or could $TST grow into something bigger, like Dogecoin or Shiba Inu?

@MEXC_Listings @BNBCHAIN @four_meme_ @yourcryptodj @Moon1ightSt The memecoin space is crowded, with new tokens appearing constantly. What makes $TST different, and does it have the potential to achieve the same level of success as established memecoins like Dogecoin or Shiba Inu?

@MEXC_Listings @BNBCHAIN @four_meme_ @yourcryptodj @Moon1ightSt Could $TST  success serve as a catalyst to attract more developers and new memecoin projects to the BSC ecosystem, similar to how Dogecoin and Shiba Inu spurred activity on Ethereu?
